CustomField.description: Pulls the value from the AT Risk Score Roll up summary field and sets the value to zero when the At Risk Status is terminated or retained.
CustomField.formula: CASE ( IM_At_Risk_Status__c,"At Risk", At_Risk_Assessment_Score__c , "Not At Risk", At_Risk_Assessment_Score__c , "Resolved", At_Risk_Assessment_Score__c , "Unknown", At_Risk_Assessment_Score__c ,"",At_Risk_Assessment_Score__c , 0)
CustomField.label: At Risk Score
